sources.name: p_schoollearner_s
sources.script:
source(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	format: 'parquet') ~> p_schoollearner_s

typeProperties.script:
section Section1;
shared p_schoollearner_s = let AdfDoc = AzureStorage.DataLakeContents("https://growecdstorage.dfs.core.windows.net/giraffe/parque/p_schoollearner_s.parquet"), Parquet = Parquet.Document(AdfDoc) in Parquet;
shared UserQuery = let  
    Source = #"p_schoollearner_s",
  #"Removed columns" = Table.RemoveColumns(Source, {"class_id", "fee", "is_confirmed", "is_standard_fee_applied", "zip_code", "other_country_of_birth_id", "doctors_name", "doctors_contact_no", "known_allergies", "created_by", "updated_by", "parent_id", "is_dormant", "profile_completed", "created_at", "special_need_description", "sassa_status"}),  
  
    // Create Full Name first  
    AddFullName = Table.AddColumn(  
        #"Removed columns",  
        "FullName",  
        each Text.Trim([first_name] & " " & [last_name]),  
        type text  
    ),  
  
    // Rename columns to Dataverse schema names  
    RenamedColumns = Table.RenameColumns(AddFullName, {
        {"address", "tcbgrow_address"}, 
        {"age_group_id", "tcbgrow_schoolagegroup"}, 
        {"id", "tcbgrow_appid"},  
        {"city_id", "tcbgrow_city"},  
        {"country_of_birth_id", "tcbgrow_country"},  
        {"date_of_birth", "tcbgrow_dateofbirth"},  
        {"enroll_date", "tcbgrow_enrolldate"},  
        {"first_name", "tcbgrow_firstname"},  
        {"gender", "tcbgrow_gender"},  
        {"id_number", "tcbgrow_idnumber"},  
        {"import", "tcbgrow_import"},  
        {"last_name", "tcbgrow_lastname"},  
        {"is_active", "tcbgrow_leaneractive"},  
        {"school_age_group_id", "tcbgrow_leanerage"},  
        {"is_special", "tcbgrow_leanerspecial"},  
        {"is_graduated", "tcbgrow_learnergraduated"},  
        {"middle_name", "tcbgrow_middlename"},  
        {"FullName", "tcbgrow_name"},  
        {"race_type_id", "tcbgrow_race"},  
        {"province_id", "cog_region"},  
        {"school_id", "tcbgrow_school"},  
        {"start_date", "tcbgrow_startdate"},  
        {"is_temporary", "tcbgrow_temporary"}  
    }, MissingField.Ignore),
  #"Capitalized each word" = Table.TransformColumns(RenamedColumns, {{"tcbgrow_gender", each Text.Proper(_), type nullable text}}),
  #"Trimmed text" = Table.TransformColumns(#"Capitalized each word", {{"tcbgrow_gender", each Text.Trim(_), type nullable text}}),
  #"Replaced value" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Trimmed text", null, "", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"tcbgrow_name", "tcbgrow_idnumber", "tcbgrow_address", "tcbgrow_middlename", "tcbgrow_lastname", "tcbgrow_firstname"})  
  
in  
    #"Replaced value";
